value.responsibility: Serialize spatial-index reads and mutations so broadcast receivers, sync workers and cache rebuilds cannot expose partially tightened nodes. Read the existing binary tree through a 64 KiB buffer and always close its input without changing the persisted format. Public clear resets size and marks removal dirty; clean load rejects header/actual-entry count mismatch, wrong child kinds and partial IO without exposing prefix nodes, preserving valid legacy bytes and same-path no-write load.
